nonblocking_findings: N1: Aggregate precedence evaluates COST-UNKNOWN (any missing ratio/CI) before PRICED-DEFICIT, so a configuration combining one UNKNOWN cell with a robust LOSS cell in another class maps to INCONCLUSIVE (park) rather than PERMANENT-DROP-BOUNDED. Verified fail-safe and the DROP branch remains reachable for pure-LOSS configurations (synthetic aggregate probe), but DIRECTOR should know a partial data-loss scenario parks rather than drops.

N2: The B-NO-REPAIR gate is vacuous by pinned-v2 construction (success hardcoded False, so the gate can never trip) — explicitly disclosed in spec and prereg, retained only for identifier stability; the live must-fail role is held by B-LITERAL-REPLAY, which the repair-signal probe confirms can fire on all three perturbation signatures. Not load-bearing for validity.

N3: True latency effects below ~3% remain straddles at N=36 by construction (1/sqrt(N) half-width projection, disclosed with a named non-shrinking-dispersion failure mode) and would PARK the thread per the mandate stop trigger. This is an honest bounded non-resolution path with a terminal product mapping, not an unsatisfiable design; the experiment still forces re-admit / permanent-drop / park-and-stop in every branch.

N4: At B_BONF=10000 the Bonferroni CI endpoints rest on ~21 bootstrap tail samples per side; Monte Carlo noise in the tail is disclosed in prereg section-7, frozen by pinned bootstrap seeds (deterministic for this packet), and recomputable by audit. Nonblocking.
